zh:
> ✨ 特别赞助商：[CodeRabbit — 业界领先的 AI 代码审查](https://coderabbit.link/usememos).

### 简单记录日常想法。 Memos 是一款开源、自托管的笔记应用，可将日常想法汇集到个人时间线中。数据由你掌握，你可以选择哪些内容保密或分享。 [演示](https://demo.usememos.com) · [安装](#快速开始) · [文档](https://usememos.com/docs) · [Discord](https://discord.gg/tfPJa4UmAv) [![Docker pulls](https://img.shields.io/docker/pulls/neosmemo/memos?style=flat-square&logo=docker)](https://hub.docker.com/r/neosmemo/memos) [![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/usememos/memos?style=flat-square&label=Release)](https://github.com/usememos/memos/releases) ## 关于 Memos Memos 是一款用于记录日常想法的开源、自托管笔记应用。 - **日常记录。** 一句话就可以是一条完整的笔记，也可以慢慢写下更长的内容，并使用 Markdown 为文字增加结构。 - **个人时间线。** 每条笔记都保留在写下它的那一天，将想法汇集成一条可供回顾的时间线。标签将不同日期的相关想法联系起来，方便你重新拾起某个话题或找到记得写过的内容。 - **自己的数据。** 记录保存在你自己的服务器上，数据由你掌握。 - **自主控制分享。** 你可以选择哪些内容保密、哪些分享给家人和朋友、哪些发布到网上。在共享空间中，你可以与他人一起记录，同时各自保留自己的笔记。 ## 快速开始 安装 Docker 后运行： ```bash docker run -d \ --name memos \ -p 5230:5230 \ -v ~/.memos:/var/opt/memos \ neosmemo/memos:stable ``` 打开 http://localhost:5230 并创建第一个账户。Memos 保存的所有内容都位于 `~/.memos`，因此请备份这个文件夹。 包括 Docker Compose、Kubernetes 和直接运行二进制文件在内的其他运行方式，请参阅[部署指南](https://usememos.com/docs/deploy)。 ## 升级 发布版本的标签格式为 `YY.MM.N`，候选版本为 `YY.MM.N-rc.K`，均无 `v` 前缀。Docker 标签 `stable` 跟随稳定版本，`26.10` 等月份标签跟随当月最新的稳定版本，`canary` 跟随开发构建版本。如果从 v0.31.0 之前的版本升级，请先运行一次 [v0.31.0](https://github.com/usememos/memos/releases/tag/v0.31.0)；请参阅[升级要求](https://github.com/usememos/memos/blob/b40d8a7b573774c52b022c8d6537d6baf2129dc0/store/migration/README.md). ## Memos 周边工具 - [Web Clipper](https://usememos.com/web-clipper) 提供 [Chrome](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/memos-web-clipper/nebaoebnljalfegiidibihhkebeiklbl) 和 [Firefox](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/memos-web-clipper/) 版本，可将网页、选中的内容和图片以 Markdown 格式保存到笔记，并附上来源链接。 - [Memogram](https://github.com/usememos/telegram-integration) 是一个 Telegram 机器人，可将消息和图片保存到 Memos。 - 通过 [API](https://usememos.com/docs/api/latest) 和 [MCP 服务器](https://usememos.com/docs/integrations/mcp)，可将 Memos 连接到自己的脚本和 AI 工具。 ## 赞助商

      

通过 [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/usememos) 赞助 Memos。 ## 帮助与贡献 如有问题，请查阅[文档](https://usememos.com/docs)，或前往 [Discord](https://discord.gg/tfPJa4UmAv) 或 [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/usememos/memos/discussions)。错误报告和想法请提交到 [issues](https://github.com/usememos/memos/issues/new/choose)。参与代码修改前，请先阅读[贡献指南](https://usememos.com/docs/development/contributing)。 ## Star 历史

## 许可证 Memos 根据 [MIT 许可证](https://github.com/usememos/memos/blob/b40d8a7b573774c52b022c8d6537d6baf2129dc0/LICENSE) 开源。
en:
> ✨ Featured sponsor: [CodeRabbit — Industry-leading AI code reviews](https://coderabbit.link/usememos).

### Simple note-taking for your everyday thoughts. Memos is an open-source, self-hosted note-taking app that brings your everyday thoughts together in a personal timeline. Your data stays yours, and you choose what to keep private or share. [Demo](https://demo.usememos.com) · [Install](#quick-start) · [Docs](https://usememos.com/docs) · [Discord](https://discord.gg/tfPJa4UmAv) [![Docker pulls](https://img.shields.io/docker/pulls/neosmemo/memos?style=flat-square&logo=docker)](https://hub.docker.com/r/neosmemo/memos) [![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/usememos/memos?style=flat-square&label=Release)](https://github.com/usememos/memos/releases) ## About Memos Memos is an open-source, self-hosted note-taking app for your everyday thoughts. - **Everyday writing.** A single sentence can be a whole memo, or you can take your time with a longer entry, using Markdown to give your words more structure. - **A personal timeline.** Each memo stays with the day you wrote it, bringing your thoughts together in a timeline you can look back through. Tags connect related thoughts across those days, making it easy to pick up a topic again or find something you remember writing. - **Your own data.** Your record lives on your own server, and your data stays yours. - **Sharing you control.** You choose what stays private, what to share with family and friends, and what to publish on the web. In shared spaces, you can write alongside others while each person keeps their own memos. ## Quick start With Docker installed, run: ```bash docker run -d \ --name memos \ -p 5230:5230 \ -v ~/.memos:/var/opt/memos \ neosmemo/memos:stable ``` Open http://localhost:5230 and create the first account. Everything Memos keeps is in `~/.memos`, so back up that one folder. Other ways to run Memos, including Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and a plain binary, are in the [deployment guide](https://usememos.com/docs/deploy). ## Upgrading Releases are tagged `YY.MM.N`, with release candidates as `YY.MM.N-rc.K` and no `v` prefix. The Docker tag `stable` follows stable releases, a month tag such as `26.10` follows the newest stable release of that month, and `canary` follows development builds. Coming from a release before v0.31.0, run [v0.31.0](https://github.com/usememos/memos/releases/tag/v0.31.0) once first; see the [upgrade requirements](https://github.com/usememos/memos/blob/b40d8a7b573774c52b022c8d6537d6baf2129dc0/store/migration/README.md). ## Around Memos - [Web Clipper](https://usememos.com/web-clipper) for [Chrome](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/memos-web-clipper/nebaoebnljalfegiidibihhkebeiklbl) and [Firefox](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/memos-web-clipper/) saves pages, selections, and images to your memos as Markdown with a link to the source. - [Memogram](https://github.com/usememos/telegram-integration) is a Telegram bot that saves your messages and images to Memos. - The [API](https://usememos.com/docs/api/latest) and [MCP server](https://usememos.com/docs/integrations/mcp) connect Memos to your own scripts and AI tools. ## Sponsors

      

Sponsor Memos through [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/usememos). ## Help and contributing Questions go to the [docs](https://usememos.com/docs), [Discord](https://discord.gg/tfPJa4UmAv), or [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/usememos/memos/discussions). Bugs and ideas go to [issues](https://github.com/usememos/memos/issues/new/choose). Code changes start with the [contributing guide](https://usememos.com/docs/development/contributing). ## Star History
